properties.name: sqllens.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable SqlLens SQL logging.

properties.name: sqllens.explain-enabled
properties.description: Enable EXPLAIN analysis for SELECT statements.

properties.name: sqllens.print-full-sql
properties.description: Print the full SQL without truncation when enabled. Overrides max-sql-length.

properties.name: sqllens.slow-threshold
properties.description: Slow query threshold in milliseconds. Queries exceeding this value will be logged at WARN level.

properties.name: sqllens.exclude-tables
properties.description: List of table name prefixes to exclude from EXPLAIN analysis.
